title: Bunk Johnson's comeback after twenty years
summary: They agree Bunk proved himself by returning after a long layoff.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I think one of the best things that we've got out of this is the fact that Buckwood really was as great as, uh, he said he was, because... He proves it, that should prove itself. Yeah. Yeah.
He didn't come back at 66 when he was no good at 30. I've heard...
I've heard musicians lay off for three years and they're shot. And here comes Buck.
And he never come back. Yeah. And I know some that didn't lay off and was shot.

But they didn't lay off. And still they were shot. Yeah. Buck lay off 20 years and came back like... like a jack. Yeah. No teeth? No, uh... In just his hat. Yeah. They didn't have no trumpet back. But it shows in the... But I'm going to take a shave. Oh, yeah. And if you want to go and get some cigarette. See what's that?
